title: The Christ concept brings all our songs into a perfect balance with our universe

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described being “transported” to “the void” while driving home: black, like a black hole; only living thing; pure torture; lasted about 8 minutes (Ft. Union exit on I-215 to about 106th South on I-15).

arrival.other_being_detail: Felt “Father in Heaven”/Christ energy; later a “male energy” that wanted to possess; later a “council”; later 3 beings in a room offering a choice; later a father-figure guide.

environment.environment_other_detail: Multiple non-ordinary states: a life-as-symphony state; Oneness state while driving; a “void”; a “council” setting; a room with three beings; and a shower “playback” vision with water droplets forming an image.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Not a single ‘return to body’ moment; multiple altered states ended/faded (Oneness ended after ~15 minutes; void ended after tethering to Christ; later chose to ‘keep going’/live in a meeting).
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Implied life-direction: permission/impetus to leave her church; emphasis on authenticity, co-creation, non-judgment, and living from ‘Christ’/Source alignment.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe stomach pain/ulcers from food allergy exposure; later dramatic heart sensations; later near-crash fear in snowstorm while driving child to hospital; later psychiatric hospitalization for suicidality/PTSD after the experience.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Raised Mormon; described upbringing as strict Christian church; marriage at 19.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Active church attendance at time; also long-term meditation practice and studying other religions/philosophies.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Nonstandard: life review as a symphony; claimed healing of food allergies/ulcer pain; ‘Oneness’ while driving; three ‘hell’ episodes including void; psych-ward visions including council/judgment and a choice meeting; perceived higher-self conversations of others; hearing scripture with perfect recall; hearing “It is done.”
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Life-review-like symphony occurred first (while in bed), followed by ongoing downloads and later Oneness/void states during ordinary activities and driving; later psych-ward visions including judgment and a choice to live.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated altered-state ‘downloads’/expanded awareness across multiple days; repeated non-auditory communications/voices.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reported being able to function normally while receiving ‘downloads’; hearing both physical and ‘higher self’ layers of conversation at once.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life review as a personal symphony harmonized with city/state/planet/universe; claimed disappearance of food allergies and ulcer pain; perceived layered ‘higher self’ conversations; ‘male energy’ offering conditional possessive love; extended ‘void’ episode; psych-ward ‘council’ judgment; explicit choice offered to ‘come home’ (die) or ‘keep going’; shower vision co-creating appearance; crystal-hand alternation to restore mental balance.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It was obvious to me that it was MY LIFE being played for me in the form of a symphony.” / “Then, Oneness… everything that was Him was also Me.” / “You and your son will not survive this trip.” / “As I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I shall fear no evil.” / “You will always be safe, but you will be mine.” / “the void… I was the ONLY living thing.” / “It is done.” / “You are Christ.” / “Do you want to come home or keep going?”
